description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Henawatta, Minintale D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No.110511
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, land title settlements, and property claims in various villages across Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa districts. The content fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership claims, and land title settlement procedures, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized category elements present.
